title: Application of Cambridge Electric Light Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 375 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 549, for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy of a change in the Fuel Charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of January and February 1998. Application is also made by Cambridge Electric Light Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power, pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. No. 404. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
